description: A sturdy dark olive-grey knee-length wool tunic with subtle red-and-cream geometric tablet-woven edging around the neck, cuffs and hem, worn over a cream linen undershirt visible at the open neck and wrists. A plain brown leather belt with rectangular brass-toned buckle and long hanging end secures the waist. Brown wool trousers, grey cloth lower-leg wraps crossed by leather ties and dark brown low leather shoes complete the outfit. No headgear, armor or weapons.
